purpose: Teach: 精力/病棟/宿命/神父/駐留/標識/国政/故意

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 若手社員、精力的に、新事業に、取り組んでいるな。
lines.en: The younger staff members are tackling the new business initiative with real energy.
lines.style: Measured, observational tone. Slight pause after the opening—taking in what he's seeing. Clear diction. The approval is quiet but present, not effusive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員病棟、近隣の病院と、提携いたしました。
lines.en: Yes. We've established a partnership with a neighboring hospital for our staff ward.
lines.style: Steady, professional delivery. Each clause lands with quiet precision. No performance—just the facts, clearly stated. Respectful formality in the posture of the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業者として、業界を支える宿命、感じている。
lines.en: As the founder, I feel the weight of responsibility to support this industry.
lines.style: Slow, thoughtful pace. Slight breath before the main clause. The words carry genuine gravity—not grandstanding, but honest reflection. Voice settles at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員のチャペル婚、神父さんを、お招きしました。
lines.en: Yes. We invited a priest to officiate the chapel wedding for one of our staff members.
lines.style: Clear, factual delivery. Brief pause to acknowledge the detail. The tone is warm without losing professionalism—recognizing the significance of the moment while staying composed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 海外駐留社員、ケア体制、強化しろ。
lines.en: Strengthen the care systems for staff stationed overseas.
lines.style: Direct, authoritative. Clipped at the edges—this is an instruction, not a negotiation. The tone is firm but not harsh; it expects compliance because it comes from clear conviction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。看板の標識、デザイン、見直し中です。
lines.en: Yes. We're reviewing the signage design at the moment.
lines.style: Brief, attentive. Quick acknowledgment of the task at hand. The tone is alert—ready to execute. No extra elaboration; just confirmation that the work is understood and underway.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 国政選挙への寄付、ガイドラインに沿って、行え。
lines.en: Campaign donations will follow the guidelines exactly.
lines.style: Firm, declarative. No room for misinterpretation. The words are measured and final—this is not a suggestion but a clear boundary being set. Steady eye-level delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。故意による不正、社内、絶対に、許しません。
lines.en: Yes. We will not tolerate any intentional misconduct within this company—not under any circumstances.
lines.style: Quiet intensity. The opening is quick, but the second half slows—each word deliberate and heavy. The final clause carries absolute finality. The voice doesn't raise, but the conviction becomes unmistakable.
